title: LAA occluders
scope: Schematic device designs in a representative appendage, not to scale. The appendage is drawn larger than in the source model so the device can be seen. Designs represent groups of devices rather than any product. Contact zones are representative, not measured. No size, fit, sealing or safety claim is made. Focal views use a representative thick-walled appendage built from the same smooth profile; they are separate from the registered source cast used for context.
stageLabel: Schematic, not to scale. Representative appendage.
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: Closed-end cage
designs.summary: A closed frame that sits inside the appendage, with its covered end facing the atrium.

designs.label: Lobe and disc
designs.summary: A lobe that anchors in the neck of the appendage, joined by a waist to a disc that covers the opening.

states.label: Contact zones
states.note: Marks where the device meets tissue in this illustration. Not a computed contact or seal.

states.label: Anatomy only
states.note: The appendage is drawn larger than in the source model so the device can be seen; it is representative, not measured anatomy.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Where the device sits in the heart
views.lesson: The appendage opens from the left atrium. A cut in the overlying structures shows the device in place.

views.label: Left heart
views.title: How the appendage relates to the left heart
views.lesson: With the right heart hidden, follow the left atrium into the appendage.

views.label: In the appendage
views.title: How the device meets the appendage wall
views.lesson: The near half of the representative thick-walled appendage is removed geometrically. Its real cut rim and retained far wall show the unchanged generic device pose; the ostium remains open.

views.label: From the atrium
views.title: What the atrium sees
views.lesson: Look through the true ostial opening of a smooth representative thick-walled appendage. This local wall replaces the source cast in this view; device coordinates are unchanged.

appendage.label: APPENDAGE
appendage.body: A pouch arising from the left atrium. It is drawn larger than the source anatomy so the device relationship is easy to see.

pouch.label: REPRESENTATIVE APPENDAGE
pouch.body: The far wall of the representative thick-walled appendage, built from the same smooth profile. This local display shell is separate from the source cast and is not measured anatomy.

opening.label: OPENING
opening.body: The open ostium of the representative appendage. Its surrounding rim is representative, while the near-half cut in the section is a display aid.

frame.label: CAGE IN PLACE
frame.body: A self-expanding frame placed inside the appendage, reached from within the heart.

cover.label: COVERED FACE
cover.body: A fabric membrane on the end that faces the atrium. It spans the opening of the appendage from inside it.

shoulder.label: SHOULDER ON THE WALL
shoulder.body: The self-expanding frame pushes outward, so its widest part presses against the wall just inside the opening.

hooks.label: ANCHORS
hooks.body: Small anchors on the outer frame engage the wall and help hold the device in place. Their number here is representative.

distal.label: CLOSED END
distal.body: The frame closes at its far end, inside the pouch. The lobes beyond it are left unfilled.

lobe.label: LOBE IN THE NECK
lobe.body: The lobe sits a short way inside the appendage, where its outward force holds it against the wall.

lobehooks.label: STABILIZING HOOKS
lobehooks.body: Hooks or barbs on the lobe add grip against the wall. Their number here is representative.

waist.label: WAIST
waist.body: A narrow connection between the lobe and the disc, which lets the disc sit on the atrial side while the lobe stays in the neck.

disc.label: DISC OVER THE OPENING
disc.body: A disc larger than the lobe covers the opening from the atrial side.

rim.label: DISC EDGE
rim.body: The edge of the disc rests on the atrial wall around the opening. The contact shown is representative.
